authority: Native canonical YAML and public Program only

predicate.axis_alignment: explicit ordered qualified axis identity; bind every axis, no implicit broadcast of external binders

method.price_basis: explicit currency, real/nominal, price year, exchange or deflation source when applicable

identities.semantic: versioned projection of admitted mathematics and all meaning-bearing bindings; do not strip arbitrary keys
identities.audit: source, binding as received, provenance and execution evidence; no evidence promotion

compatibility: Explicit fail-closed dispatch, private predicate helper shared unchanged, no implicit conversion between package versions; both clients use same admitted package and snapshot.

workstreams.A: external obligations and scope; consume predicate client
workstreams.B: method context, output and evidence; consume method client

supported_packages.restriction: bounded positive dimensionless dynamic integer power
